claim: The held-line table a session's second count of the same shelf lands in (stock_count_held_lines) enables RLS, gives service_role the only policy and revokes anon and authenticated (OD-72/OD-73). Killed by dropping its CREATE, ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY, REVOKE or service_role policy line.
verify: python3 -c "import sys;s=open('supabase/migrations/20270113100000_a_count_names_its_open_bottles.sql').read();t='stock_count_held_lines';sys.exit(0 if ('CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.%s ('%t) in s and ('ALTER TABLE public.%s ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;'%t) in s and ('REVOKE ALL ON public.%s FROM anon, authenticated;'%t) in s and 'FOR ALL TO service_role USING (true) WITH CHECK (true)' in s else 1)"

claim: Lane 2 keeps ADR 0078's single count writer: its migration defines exactly one function, record_stock_count, which gains p_counted_open_ml and p_session_id as defaulted trailing parameters after a DROP of the old signature, so no overload and no second open-bottle writer exists. Killed by a second CREATE FUNCTION in the file, removing the DROP, or dropping either parameter.
verify: python3 -c "import re,sys;s=open('supabase/migrations/20270113100000_a_count_names_its_open_bottles.sql').read();f=re.findall(r'CREATE\s+(?:OR\s+REPLACE\s+)?FUNCTION',s,re.I);sys.exit(0 if len(f)==1 and 'CREATE FUNCTION public.record_stock_count(' in s and 'DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.record_stock_count(' in s and re.search(r'p_counted_open_ml\s+integer\s+default\s+null',s) and re.search(r'p_session_id\s+uuid\s+default\s+null',s) else 1)"

claim: stock_counts carries expected_open_ml and counted_open_ml (integer ml, F3 tenths are converted before the writer) that are both null or both set, with counted_open_ml never negative. Killed by dropping either column or either CHECK.
verify: python3 -c "import sys;s=open('supabase/migrations/20270113100000_a_count_names_its_open_bottles.sql').read();sys.exit(0 if 'ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS expected_open_ml integer' in s and 'ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS counted_open_ml  integer' in s and 'ADD CONSTRAINT stock_counts_open_ml_counted_together' in s and 'ADD CONSTRAINT stock_counts_counted_open_ml_not_negative' in s else 1)"

claim: A session count line answers staff without the expected figure or the variance (DASH-G6): the controller swaps the count for blindCountForStaff(out.count) when a session is named and the caller does not hold the house's money, and the tenths-to-ml conversion lives in the same module. Killed by removing the holdsHouseMoney test or the blind helper.
verify: python3 -c "import re,sys;r=open('apps/api-gateway/src/inventory/stock-count-result.ts').read();c=open('apps/api-gateway/src/inventory/inventory.controller.ts').read();sys.exit(0 if 'export function blindCountForStaff(' in r and 'export function openTenthsToMl(' in r and re.search(r'dto\?\.sessionId && !holdsHouseMoney\(user\?\.role \?\? null\)\s*\?\s*\{ count: blindCountForStaff\(out\.count\) \}',c) else 1)"
